# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Multi-Platform Sidebar Sections & Placeholder Workspaces

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, completeness, and clarity for multi-platform navigation and placeholder interfaces
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all five requested platforms (Instagram, Threads, X (Twitter), TikTok, YouTube) explicitly enumerated with their display names and brand icons? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are navigation route mappings specified for every upcoming platform Accounts sub-item? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the exact copy and placement of the testing status note documented for both sidebar and placeholder views? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are keyboard accessibility and ARIA roles specified for all new interactive sidebar triggers and buttons? [Completeness, Spec §SC-004]

## Requirement Clarity & Design Standards

- [ ] CHK005 Is the default collapse/expand behavior for new platform sections unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are active link visual indicators specified to use canonical theme tokens without capsule pills? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the placeholder note text free of technical plumbing jargon or infrastructure terms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK008 Are behavior requirements defined for sidebar icon-only collapsed state (`state === 'collapsed'`) for all new platforms? [Edge Case, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK009 Are mobile drawer closing requirements defined when a user taps an Accounts sub-item? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are recovery/exit navigation paths defined for users visiting placeholder account pages? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
